query: numeric results src must not regress while another result improves

metrics.description: Metres of error in the pallet pose estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 publishes as tx, ty, tz, and yaw_rad. Later edits must not increase it while another numeric result improves.
witnesses: The user is the vehicle's dynamic handling process: it needs a pallet pose while the scene can still change.

witnesses: the pallet width, height, and depth in metres

metrics.description: Error in which detection select_detection sends through stage 2 versus the detections left deferred. Later edits must not increase it while another numeric result improves.

metrics.description: Combined error of the pallet pose, the pallet dimensions in metres, and stage-2 versus deferred selection. Later edits must not increase it while another numeric result improves.
